### 1 — Scene
A tray meal with six large sushi rolls, a small chicken-and-vegetable salad, a chocolate-chip cookie, dipping condiments, and a dark soft drink. All appear to belong to this meal.

### 2 — Vessels
- Sushi plate: approximately **23 cm** diameter; area **415 cm²**.
- Cookie plate: approximately **23 cm**; area **415 cm²**.
- Salad bowl: approximately **20 cm**; opening area **314 cm²**.
- Small condiment cups and a roughly 400 ml drink cup.

### 3–7 — Items, coverage, volume, weight, and energy
Coverage percentages refer to each item's own vessel. Sushi is estimated as a complete roll mixture, including rice, seaweed, fish, and vegetables.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Gross volume calculation | Density (g/ml) | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Six sushi rolls | 40% | 166 cm² × 2.5 cm = 415 ml | 0.80 | 332 | 155 | 515 |
| Salad leaves | 35% | 110 cm² × 2 cm = 220 ml | 0.15 | 33 | 15 | 5 |
| Tomato, cucumber, other salad vegetables | 25% | 79 cm² × 1.2 cm = 95 ml | 0.60 | 57 | 22 | 13 |
| Chicken pieces in salad | 10% | 31 cm² × 1 cm = 31 ml | 0.95 | 30 | 165 | 50 |
| Chocolate-chip cookie | 13% | 54 cm² × 0.85 cm = 46 ml | 0.90 | 41 | 490 | 201 |
| Soy sauce | ~80% of small cup | 10 cm² × 1.8 cm = 18 ml | 1.00 | 18 | 55 | 10 |
| Pickled ginger | ~70% of small cup | 11 cm² × 1.5 cm = 17 ml | 0.60 | 10 | 60 | 6 |
| Wasabi | ~25% of small cup | 4 cm² × 1 cm = 4 ml | 1.00 | 4 | 110 | 4 |
| Dark soft drink | Full liquid footprint | 44 cm² × 8 cm ≈ 350 ml | 1.00 | 350 | 42 | 147 |

The salad covers approximately **70%** of its bowl opening; the sushi covers **40%** of its plate, and the cookie **13%**. No separate oil or dressing is clearly identifiable, so none is added.

### 8 — Sanity check
Estimated food and condiments weigh **625 g**, plus **350 g** of drink: approximately **975 g and 950 kcal total**. This is plausible for six substantial sushi pieces, a small salad, and a cookie. The drink is assumed to be regular soda; a diet drink would reduce the estimate by about **147 kcal**.
